title: Retention schedule and deletion flow specification (draft)
summary: Write the retention schedule for every data class in SPEC §7 and specify the per-user delete-all flow, including vendor-side deletion. Draft for counsel review before M5.

acceptance_tests.test: legal/RETENTION_SCHEDULE.md has one row per data class in SPEC §7: retention period, deletion trigger, storage location, who can access, and the vendor involved.

Raw scan media is deleted on successful derivation and no later than 24 h; failed jobs within 7 days; face and body photos immediately after avatar generation on device, in storage, and at the vendor.
legal/DELETION_FLOW.md specifies delete-all: entry point in settings, steps per data class, vendor deletion calls and receipts, 30-day completion, what the user sees, and how it is tested on staging.
Both files marked DRAFT pending attorney review and cross-referenced from SPEC §7 wording (no SPEC edit needed).
